failed: The service could not handle this.

request.conflict: This request ID is already in use for something else.
request.browserUnsupported: The browser can’t do this. Use the desktop client.

connection.unauthorized:
The service token is wrong.
Check the token you were given at installation, without leading or trailing spaces; after changing it on the server, use the new one. Repeated failures are refused for a while.
connection.versionMismatch: The client and the service ({{version}}) are different versions. One of them needs upgrading.
connection.tunnelFailed:
The service could not set up the execution channel.
Check the service log; this happens when the data directory is not writable or the server is out of resources.
connection.sshFailed: The tunnel is up, but this computer’s SSH service did not run the probe command.
connection.sshFailedSaid:
The tunnel is up, but this computer’s SSH service did not run the probe command.
This computer answered: {{said}}

device.unknownProject: That computer has no such project.
device.unknown: The client did not say which computer it is.
device.onWindows: This session is on a Windows computer. To go on with it here, choose a project folder on this computer for it, or fork it to this computer.
device.notReady: This computer’s execution channel is not ready yet. Wait a moment; the client is connecting or reconnecting.
device.notReadyShort: This computer’s execution channel is not ready yet.
device.otherOffline: “{{name}}” is offline. Its sessions can be worked on here once it connects to the service; you can also move the session to this computer or fork it here.
device.otherNotReady: The execution channel of “{{name}}” is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.

capacity_one: The service runs at most {{count}} run or terminal at a time (estimated from the server’s memory; set PROXY_MAX_RUNS to change it). Try again when other work has finished.
capacity_other: The service runs at most {{count}} runs or terminals at a time (estimated from the server’s memory; set PROXY_MAX_RUNS to change it). Try again when other work has finished.

simulation.noAccount: The offline simulation has no native account.
simulation.noAccountState: The offline simulation has no native account state.
simulation.noTerminal: The offline simulation does not start terminals.
simulation.noCompaction: The offline simulation does not compact native context.
simulation.noSettings: The offline simulation has no native settings.
simulation.noInstructions: The offline simulation has no global instructions.
simulation.toolSkipped: The simulated tool did not run.

account.busy: End native runs and terminals before managing the account.
account.loginEnded: The sign-in has ended. Get a new link.
account.cancelLoginFirst: Cancel the browser sign-in in progress first.
account.tokenSaveFailed: Could not save the setup token: {{detail}}
account.statusAfterRun: Refresh the native status once the run has ended.
account.authTimeout: Timed out waiting for the official authorization. Get a new link.
account.tokenUnread: The official setup-token exited successfully, but no token could be read from its output. Check the CLI version and its output format.
account.loginExit: The official sign-in command exited abnormally (exit code {{code}}) with no error output.
account.noLink: The official sign-in command ended before giving an authorization link.
account.noToken_one: No token after {{count}} second. Generate a new link.
account.noToken_other: No token after {{count}} seconds. Generate a new link.
account.noTokenSaid_one: No token after {{count}} second. Generate a new link. (Official command: {{said}})
account.noTokenSaid_other: No token after {{count}} seconds. Generate a new link. (Official command: {{said}})
account.tokenNotSaved: The token was created but could not be saved: {{detail}}

terminal.notOwner: The terminal belongs to another connection.
terminal.endedOrNotOwner: The terminal has ended or belongs to another connection.
terminal.busy: End this session’s run or session changes before opening a terminal.
terminal.startFailed: The terminal failed to start. Check the Linux PTY component and the CLI.

session.manageRunActive: End the current run before managing the session.
session.updateFailed: The native session could not be updated; the proxy’s record is kept. Check the native storage and its permissions.
session.forkRunActive: End the current run before forking the session.
session.forkFailed: The native session could not be forked; no new session was created. That point may not be in the native record.
session.moveRunActive: End the current run before moving the session to another computer.
session.compactNoContext: Start a native session before compacting its context.
session.updating: The session is being updated. Try again shortly.
session.inCcdt: This session is open in ccdt. Exit that terminal before working on it here.
session.deleteRunActive: Stop the run before deleting the session.
session.modeRunActive: End the current run before changing the approval mode.
session.projectRunActive: End the current run before changing the project.
session.renameRunActive: End the current run before renaming.

run.stopping: The native run is stopping. Send again shortly.
run.statusReading: The native status is being read. Send again shortly.
run.ended: The run has ended; nothing was done.
run.adapterFailed: The native process adapter failed. Check the service configuration and the CLI version.
run.contextMissing: Claude Code’s native context does not exist. Nothing is faked from the window’s record and no new session is started. Check the native storage and backups.
run.finishing: The native run is finishing. Send once it has ended.
run.inputBusy: Many messages are already waiting for the native run. Send again shortly.

approval.answered: This has already been answered, perhaps on another computer.
approval.planOnly: Only Claude’s plans take a way of carrying them out.
approval.inactive: The approval is no longer active.

settings.failed: The native settings file can’t be read or written. Check it with /config in ccdt.

instructions.failed: The global instructions file can’t be read or written.
instructions.tooLong_one: The global instructions are over {{count}} character. Edit them with /memory in ccdt.
instructions.tooLong_other: The global instructions are over {{count}} characters. Edit them with /memory in ccdt.
instructions.changed: The global instructions were changed elsewhere. Reload them before editing.

stopped.userNative: Stopped by the user. SSH commands already sent may go on running; their effects are not undone and nothing is retried.
stopped.disconnected: The connection was lost; the run was not replayed.
stopped.disconnectedNative: The connection was lost; the run was not replayed. Commands under way may or may not have finished.
stopped.offline_one: The computer was offline for more than {{count}} second, so the run was stopped. Commands under way may or may not have finished.
stopped.offline_other: The computer was offline for more than {{count}} seconds, so the run was stopped. Commands under way may or may not have finished.
stopped.serviceStopped: The service stopped; the run was not replayed.
stopped.serviceRestarted: The service restarted; the run was not replayed.

notice.cacheExpiring_one: {{count}} minute since the last turn ended, so the prompt cache is about to expire: compacting the context as set, which reads the cache.
notice.cacheExpiring_other: {{count}} minutes since the last turn ended, so the prompt cache is about to expire: compacting the context as set, which reads the cache.
notice.terminalRewound: The conversation was rewound in the terminal; some of the above is no longer in context.
notice.terminalSwitched: The terminal switched to another conversation (/clear or /resume); what follows there is not in this session.
notice.backgroundOff: Could not move it to the background: Claude Code on this computer has background tasks turned off.
notice.metricsFailed: The native status of this turn could not be read; the task’s results are not affected.
notice.loginExpiring_one: Claude Code’s sign-in ends in about {{count}} day ({{date}}). After that, sign in again under “Account & quota”.
notice.loginExpiring_other: Claude Code’s sign-in ends in about {{count}} days ({{date}}). After that, sign in again under “Account & quota”.
notice.loginExpired: Claude Code’s sign-in may have ended ({{date}}). If requests start failing, sign in again under “Account & quota”.
notice.modeMismatch: Asked for approval mode {{requested}}; the native process reports {{reported}}.
notice.writesLost: {{disk}}, so Claude Code could not save {{lost, parts}}. Free up space on the server.
notice.diskQuota: The server’s disk quota is used up
notice.lostTranscript: part of the session record (when the session goes on, Claude may not see this conversation)

update.untracked: This service does not track versions.
update.upgrading: The service is upgrading. Send again once it has restarted.
update.held: {{reasons, clauses}}. Upgrading restarts the service and interrupts them: upgrade when they are done, or force the upgrade.
update.mutating: a session is being moved or changed
update.signingIn: the Claude account is signing in
update.releasesUnreachable: The releases page can’t be reached ({{status}}). To track a private repository, give the service a read-only token.
update.releasesFailed: The request to the releases page failed ({{status}}).
update.badManifest: release.json is not in the expected format.
update.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than the release manifest says.
update.notAvailable: This version can’t be installed. Check for updates first.
update.notFinished: The upgrade did not finish; still running {{version}}: {{reason}}

project.moveRunActive: A session in this project is running. Change the folder once it ends.

fork.midRun: A message added during a run can’t be a fork point.

history.resumeCursor: The resume cursor is beyond the history.
history.cursor: The history cursor is out of range.
history.stalled: No receipt for the history transfer for 30 seconds. Try again.

tool.restartedUnknown: The service restarted; the tool’s final result is unconfirmed and it is not replayed.
tool.restartedSimulated: The service restarted; the simulated tool did not run.
tool.endedUnknown: The run ended; the tool’s final result is unconfirmed. SSH commands already sent may go on running; their effects are not undone and nothing is replayed.

status.readFailed: Could not read from the native interface
status.readTimeout: Reading from the native interface timed out

web.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.

web.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again.

web.proxyAddress: Enter the IP address of the trusted reverse proxy.

web.sessionLimit: There are too many signed-in browsers. Sign some out first.
web.loginUnavailable: Signing in is unavailable for now.

certificate.chainFormat: Provide the certificate chain in PEM format.
certificate.keyFormat: Provide an unencrypted PEM private key.

certificate.keyMismatch: The certificate and private key do not match.

certificate.restoreFirst: Restore the default certificate before changing the access domain.
